title: WPSS/1072/2019 of PRABHA DEVI Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND

paras.text:
WPSS No. 1072 of 2019
Honíble Manoj K. Tiwari, J.
Mr. Harendra Belwal, Advocate for the
petitioner.
Mr. M.C. Tewari, Deputy Advocate
General for the State of Uttarakhand.
Heard learned counsel for the parties.
Late Shri Jagat Ram Semwal was a
Class IV employee in Education Department.
He died on 22.10.2014. Petitioner is the
second wife of late Shri Jagat Ram Semwal.
After death of her husband, petitioner
applied for compassionate appointment on
13.02.2015. According to the petitioner,
Principal of the concerned College had
recommended her case to the Chief
Education Officer and the matter was
thereafter sent to the State Government
through Director, Elementary Education.
Grievance of the petitioner is that no
decision has been taken on her request for
compassionate appointment so far.
Learned counsel for the petitioner
confines his prayer and prayed that writ
petition may be disposed of by directing the
Competent Authority to take decision in the
matter at the earliest.
 Accordingly, writ petition is disposed of
with a direction to Director, Elementary
Education to examine the claim of the
petitioner and pass appropriate order, in
accordance with law, within a period of eight
weeks from the date of production of
certified copy of this order.
 (Manoj K. Tiwari, J.)
Arpan 10.05.2019
